[b]Donations and Condemnations[/b]

With Thýven in a steady state of collapse after the failure of the Mendanevist government, Hydronia has decided to repay a favour to Thýven. When Hydronia came out of the THEP-EDU war, Thýven (then a constituent kingdom of Elseyr-Vespurias) help boost the Hydronian economy back into a stable place through donations. Now it was Hydronias turn. After a close vote in the parliamentary assembly, the government would authorise the donation of 30 billion gilders to the bank of Tharkønn, arriving in monthly payments of 5 billion. Additionally, the Hydronian government will invest a further 5 billion gilders in Thývenic stocks and shares to help recuperate the stock market.

The Hydronian government has expressed strong condemnation of the EDU for their aggression in the white strait, in particular their Argossian partner, the USO due to their heavy-handed wielding of nuclear weapons, which have deliberately escalated the situation in the white strait. President Hakan Bozkan would state that the EDU are the sole escalators of this conflict. Hydronia will place heavy sanctions on the entire EDU (including the USO), whilst enforcing a 35% tariff on all Republik goods that are imported as part of the Republik-Hydronia deal. As for this deal, Hydronia has urged the Republik to accept the implementation of Hydronian-proposed amendments to the deal, offering to remove tariffs of the Republik if they comply. However, If the Republik refuses one again to amend the deal, Hydronia will fully withdraw from the deal. President Hakan Bozkan has stated that Hydronia can easily fall back on THEP members for economic support if needed, whereas the Neue Republik has only the EDU, a statistically smaller share of the global market and an alliance limited to a single continent which can only produce a select amount of products.

Whilst Hydronia may be levying heavy sanctions on the EDU, the government has also expressed its continued commitment to attend peace talks, as well as fully supporting the western-view proposed idea of holding peace talks in the neutral IDZRC territory.

As well as condemning the Neue Republik and its allies for the rapid escalation of events in the white strait, Hydronia has also strongly condemned the Neue Republiks veto of a Hydronian-written IA resolution to bring help bring IA peacekeepers in Valddera. President Hakan Bozkan has called out the Neue Republik as "an entity incapable of caring for the wellbeing of common people".

After weeks of friendly diplomatic talks in Hydropolis with delegates from Nordiheim, Hydronia has agreed to accept a new naval deal with Nordiheim and the Bobian commonwealth to further the naval cooperation and capabilities of the 3 nations. Several Hydronian companies are set to be involved in the project, including many big names that manufacture current Hydronian naval equipment, such as Badem Seas and Hydron-Deniz naval.

[quote=ekpatanus;60658601]Official Statement of the Kingdom of Ekpatanus  
Date: 17 September 2026  
Government Spokesperson: Jürgen Andropoulos

The Kingdom of Ekpatanus reminds all parties that the recent military and economic tensions could easily escalate into an irreversible war  a war in which the only true losers would be the defenseless people of Tallisland. Rather than turning Tallisland into scorched earth, we propose a temporary ceasefire and the immediate opening of negotiations on the future of Tallisland between the members of the EDU and FNTO, the Anti-Principalist government of Tallisland, and its allies, to be hosted in a neutral country.

Should this proposal be ignored, the Kingdom of Ekpatanus will, after 72 hours, be obliged to initiate economic and political sanctions against the Second Flouesch Republic and Thýven.  

[/quote]

[b]Late Registration[/b]

In light of the immense loss of life during the Karwbridc Naval Office assault, both Kjersti Stennes and Holy President Clifford Prisk (under pressure from the Vice President and Prime Minister) have agreed to open up negotiations for an end to the conflict. The Principalist government opted to send High War-Priest Wojciech Saebaldr to represent the interests of Tallisland, especially pertaining to the loss of life of Tallislandic soldiers, whereas the Anti-Principalists have chosen Michał Grabarczyk to represent them.

Patriarch Błoński refused to comment on the situation, though Prime Minister Elwira Piekarz agreed to speak on the behalf of the Patriarch and Holy President. "God is the most truly hurt by gruesome conflicts such as these, faithful fighting faithful, so it is the duty of all true Lusandrics to champion peace so that we may all pray for redemption as one." 

No Anti-Principalist figure was able to comment on the peace negotiations, though reacts among their supporters online appear to be mixed.

[b]October 19-23, 2026: The Radical 20s[/b]

Following the decrees of October 18th Piter Drømm would begin a series of purges to ensure the stability of the constitutional conventions that were forming in the Principates under the guidance of the Princes. Firstly he issued on October 19th a declaration that fully stripped delegates of the Mendenavist Party (United Orthodox Front) of their powers of representation, ordering the IDF (Of which Lenstahl had granted control to him in private meeting on the 17th of October) to ensure the revocation of the government passes of the Mendenavists was carried out.

Furthermore he would repudiate the memory of Patriarch Mendenav, requesting on the 20th before the Council of 200, that the church either excommunicate or exile him, causing a major stir in the Orthodox faithful, as the government hadnt confronted the church in such a way since the 1950s.

On October 21st he would travel to the City-Confederation of North Thýven to oversee ceremonially the first elections of that government, backing in a speech the communist partys candidate for chairman Erjk Malben to a cheering crowd, stating, Mendenav gave us a choice, and Freedom is what we chose,.

By October 22nd Piter Drømm had moved to establish a transition council, consisting of the five princes, though it was agreed that Piter Drømm would wield full authority on the council until the constitutions of the Principates were finalised. In the meantime he moved to secure the Armed Forces, requesting that Lenstahl freeze the assets of any general or military official who opposed the interim council, deploying IDF spies to ensure and coerce the armed forces to loyalty. 

All of these rapid-fire actions would deeply unsettle the establishment nobility and politicians, who warned in the papers and news that Drømm was attempting to restore the dictatorship of the 40s-70s through his actions. Protests would begin to pop up in the Principate of Angmaar, a principate that covered the eastern coast of Thýven. 

In the meantime the economy would continue to falter as the rapid changes continued to unsettle investors and companies alike, Drømm had made no attempt to court the business elite during this period, and markets had continued to dip slowly, dropping another 400 points following the announcement on the 18th. Once again the corporations would threaten to begin to withdraw from Thýven and move their operations offshore if some establishment of normalcy wasnt made by the new government. 

However, as protests broke out, fellow THEP ally Hydronia would announce a saving grace with the deliverance of almost 5 Billion Gilders worth of aid to the bank of Tharkønn with continued payments to total 30 Billion Gilders over the next six months. The government of Hydronia, further seeking to aid its ally, would invest 5 Billion further Gilders in a variety of Thývenic stocks. The aid would be well received by the bank and markets which would see a moderate uptick by the close of the 23rd. Though the Bank of Tharkønn would warn the interim council that if a national budget resolution was not completed the bank would be unable to disperse necessary spending funds. Thus the countdown began.
